observations: Photo 0: Closed laptop showing back lid with 'VICTUS' logo and a V-shaped emblem. The surface is matte black with a slight gradient. Watermark 'FLEMZ INTEGRATED SYSTEMS' is visible.

Photo 1: Open laptop showing Windows 11 desktop with blue default wallpaper. Keyboard is black with white lettering. 'VICTUS' branding is visible on the palm rest and below the screen. Stickers on the bottom right: Intel Core i7, NVIDIA GeForce, and a small '510' sticker. A white label is on the bottom left of the palm rest, but text is unreadable.
